command:
if [ "${FLEET_BUILD_BEND_TOOLS:-0}" = 1 ]; then
  export HOME="$PWD/.fleet-bend-home"
  mkdir -p "$HOME/.bend" || exit $?
  tar -xzf .fleet-bend-tools.tar.gz -C "$HOME/.bend" || exit $?
  export BEND="$HOME/.bend/bin/bend"
  export PATH="$HOME/.bend/bin:$PATH"
fi
cd "$1" && shift
case ${FLEET_BUILD_JDK:-} in
  17) [ -n "${JAVA17_HOME:-}" ] || { echo "fleet-build: no JDK 17 on $(hostname)" >&2; exit 3; }; export JAVA_HOME=$JAVA17_HOME ;;
  21) [ -n "${JAVA21_HOME:-}" ] || { echo "fleet-build: no JDK 21 on $(hostname)" >&2; exit 3; }; export JAVA_HOME=$JAVA21_HOME ;;
esac
[ -n "${JAVA_HOME:-}" ] && export PATH=$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH
case $1 in
  ./gradlew|gradlew|gradle)
    g=$1; shift
    # FLEET_GRADLE_ARGS is word-split on purpose; "\ " keeps a space inside one flag.
    eval "set -- $FLEET_GRADLE_ARGS \"\$@\""
    set -- "$g" "$@"
    echo "fleet-build: $*" >&2 ;;
esac
exec "$@"

mkdir proof-home && tar -xzf proof-tools.tar.gz -C proof-home && export HOME=$PWD/proof-home BEND=$PWD/proof-home/.bend/bin/bend PATH=$PWD/proof-home/.bend/bin:$PATH && (cd owner_standing && $BEND PROOF.bend --verdict > verdict-mbp.txt 2>&1; cat verdict-mbp.txt) && (cd owner_standing && BEND=$BEND python3 mutations.py > mutations-mbp.json; echo mut_rc=$?)
